Bromhexine has been shown to enhance the penetration of erythromycin into bronchial secretions.1 Although bromhex- ine is used as an adjuvant in the treatment of respiratory infec- tions, few controlled studies appear to have been conducted to determine if any additional benefit is obtained. However, some studies have found improved responses with cefalexin2 and amoxicillin.3 1. Bergogne-Berezin E, et al.
